required_facts.fact: Milla Jovovich and Ben Sigman launched MemPalace.
It runs locally with ChromaDB and PyYAML.
Memory classification uses deterministic heuristics without LLM API calls.
The hierarchy contains wings, rooms, halls and drawers.
Drawers preserve source text chunks verbatim.
Four loading levels manage token budgets.
A SQLite knowledge graph stores temporal validity.
The project reports 96.6% recall@5 on LongMemEval.

author_attribution: Present Alexey as examining the project; attribute MemPalace to Jovovich and Sigman.
